metrics.population: every PRD-required typed relationship family/direction, including explicit supported, absent-data, and insufficient-evidence scenarios
metrics.rationale: Prevents sparse relation gold from making missing business-required families invisible; absent source data remains an explicit blocking gap rather than a false zero.

metrics.population: each reviewed supported relationship family/direction with non-empty gold
metrics.rationale: Requires useful reach without pretending data-absent relationship families are zero-quality retrieval.
Balances relation reach with edge precision; wrong-identity edges remain a zero-tolerance invariant.

metrics.population: 25 user-confirmed workbook cases, interpreting known-bad responses by key points
metrics.rationale: Uses case-specific reference gold without enforcing verbatim templates.

metrics.measurement: claim-part coverage over the validated evidence set
metrics.population: reviewed material answer parts that have available evidence
metrics.rationale: Rewards useful completeness while unsupported claims remain zero-tolerance.

metrics.measurement: agreement on pass/fail plus score correlation, reported by family/domain
metrics.rationale: LLM judgment can scale evaluation only after agreement with human labels is demonstrated.

metrics.measurement: scenario-level correct binding rate by context family
metrics.population: reviewed anchor, referent, displayed-set, narrowing, and traversal turns
metrics.rationale: Measures correct user-reference resolution while identity mutation remains forbidden.

metrics.population: reviewed explicit and implicit topic-switch turns
metrics.rationale: Prevents stale anchors from contaminating a new user topic.

metrics.measurement: human-reviewed Web candidate relevance at K=5
metrics.population: reviewed current-Web candidates for information requests
metrics.rationale: Universal Web augmentation must add useful current evidence without overwhelming local precision.

metrics.population: complex cross-domain/Web progressive-answer routes with progress events
metrics.rationale: Provides a generous bounded completion budget while TTFT/progress protects perceived latency.
A generous safety ceiling allows extensive LLM/Web use while preventing runaway call loops.
Allows richer multi-stage reasoning under an explicit finite ceiling.

metrics.measurement: p95 provider-reported monetary cost ratio with identical versioned inputs
metrics.population: same route/corpus/provider configuration versus its accepted baseline
metrics.rationale: Caps unexplained p95 monetary-cost regression at 20% after an initial real-provider baseline exists.
